properties.name: A Question's wording is immutable and says so; and at genesis the islands are the plan, not a defect
properties.rationale:
KEYED ON ZERO COMPONENTS DIRECTLY, NOT ON `concept_without_design`'s OUTPUT. Both would give the same answer today, and that is exactly the risk: a rule consulting another rule's findings can disagree with it later, which is the second-implementation hazard `structure.rs` already names about `isolated_in_walk`. The predicate is one method with two readers — the detector skips, the sweep lists — on the pattern the code endorses for `parked_nodes` delegating to `is_parked`.

⚠️ THE FIRST IMPLEMENTATION THREADED THE LIST THROUGH FOUR FUNCTIONS and was abandoned. `detect_defects -> open_defects_counting -> all_defects -> detect_structural_defects` would each have carried an out-parameter for a value only the last one produces. Computing the island walk once in `sweep_scope`, with the detector needing only a boolean, keeps the rule single-sourced without the plumbing.

⚠️ IT IS A PHASE, NOT AN EXEMPTION, and a test pins that: the moment a design declares any structure the rule reports normally again. Without that, this would be a permanent silencer wearing a phase's clothes — the exact failure `swept.parked` exists to avoid, reintroduced one rule over.

⚠️ NOT ESTABLISHED: whether other detectors fire on the same genesis state. chama reported 10 defects of which 8 were this rule; the other 2 were never diagnosed, and nobody has swept a fresh design to see what else speaks too early.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
The last two of the seven decisions from the chama and dev_storyflow triage, both settled by Anthony 2026-09-02.

**#2 — A RECORDED QUESTION'S WORDING IS IMMUTABLE, AND THAT IS NOW STATED.** Two projects went looking for an edit tool after their questions were recorded in degraded form, and the absence cost them more than the bad wording did. Ruling: it stays immutable — a Question records WHAT WAS ASKED, and the `answer` beside it was given to those exact words, so editing would make the record a claim about what somebody wishes they had asked.

Said in the two places an agent actually stands: `withdraw_question`'s description (the tool they reach for) now states outright that it is NOT an edit tool and that none exists, and points at the real cause of jargon phrasing — the replay guard, fixed the same day, so asking again now produces the phrasing you meant. `Question.question`'s schema description carries the same, framed as by design and not by oversight.

⭐ PINNED, UNDER AGENTS.md RULE 8 WRITTEN HOURS EARLIER. Those sentences claim "no tool edits this field" — a claim about the code — so two tests assert it: answering never rewrites the question, and withdrawing preserves the wording rather than erasing it. The rule's first application was to the change that followed it.

**#3 — AT GENESIS THE ISLANDS ARE THE PLAN.** `proj:chama` ran `detect_defects` ten minutes into its first design: 10 structural defects, 8 of them `unthreaded_cluster`, every requirement sitting with its satisfying capability. That shape is what the genesis skill INSTRUCTS, `concept_without_design` fires at the same state and describes it approvingly, and `CONTAINS` is not a traceability edge — so a design with zero Components CANNOT thread by construction. Two rules read one graph state and one called it a defect.

`unthreaded_cluster` now skips when no Component exists, and `swept.expected_at_this_phase` LISTS what it skipped. Visible and counted, never silenced — the bargain `swept.parked` already struck.
